notes:
You can now open the Ambient Sounds mixer without leaving distraction-free mode: the ♫ button sits in the floating toolbar, next to play/stop, whenever Ambient Sounds is enabled. Press Escape to close the mixer and keep writing; press it again to leave distraction-free mode.

- On Windows, a chapter changed outside Corylus — in another editor, or by Dropbox or a similar service — now shows its new text straight away. Before, the open copy kept the old text, and new files added to the project folder did not appear in the binder until you reopened it.
